name: Rental market survey (Statistics Norway table 09895)

measures.definition: Sitting rent: the average monthly rent of every surveyed tenancy of a 2-room home (one bedroom; Norwegian rooms leave out the kitchen) in the Oslo and Bærum price zone, old and new tenancies.
Sitting rent: the average monthly rent of every surveyed tenancy of a 4-room home (three bedrooms) in the Oslo and Bærum price zone.

rights.attribution: Statistics Norway (SSB), table 09895: Rental market survey, average monthly rents, CC BY 4.0 (www.ssb.no)

vetted.notes: Official, every tenancy; rooms counted without the kitchen.

caveats: Oslo and Bærum form one price zone; SSB warns that yearly samples differ, so year-to-year changes are not exact.
